title: Anti-Bucket List: No Journal
short_description: Write down what you said no to and check later if you're still glad.

guides.title: How to Keep a Journal of Things You Said No To
guides.description: A step-by-step way to record what you declined, why it felt that way, and when to review it. Includes a 30 and 90 day check-in schedule.

guides.title: Regret Rate Calculator: How Often Do You Regret No?
guides.description: Work out your regret rate for the things you declined. Formula, a worked example and a small calculator you can use right here.
